title.target: méiyǒu rén pèng de tiě huáng

pairs.target: kāifàngrì bàngwǎn , tǎ wéi xiān rènchū le xié shàng de ní .
pairs.english: On the evening of the open day, the first thing Tavi recognized was the mud on people's shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 开放日傍晚，塔维先认出了鞋上的泥。

pairs.target: láikè bǎ běi gōngfáng de mén jǐ dé yìkāi yì hé ,
pairs.english: Visitors crowded through the north workshop door, making it swing open and shut.
pairs.hanzi: 来客把北工房的门挤得一开一合，

pairs.target: yǒurén de xuē biān zhān zhe shàigān de héní , yǒurén chuānzhe gāng cā guò de ruǎnxié .
pairs.english: Some had dried river mud clinging around their boots; others wore freshly polished soft shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 有人的靴边沾着晒干的河泥，有人穿着刚擦过的软鞋。

pairs.target: ménwài mài rè bǐng de yǐjīng hǎn le bàntiān , xiāngwèi shùnzhe rén fèng zuānjìnlái .
pairs.english: Outside, the hot-bread seller had been calling for ages, and the smell slipped in through gaps between people.
pairs.hanzi: 门外卖热饼的已经喊了半天，香味顺着人缝钻进来。

pairs.target: pà wò bǎ yíkuài bǐng sāijìn tǎ wéi shǒulǐ , shuō xiān chī , děng tā chūmíng jiù méikòng le .
pairs.english: Pavo pressed a piece of bread into Tavi's hand and told him to eat first: once he was famous he would have no time.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃把一块饼塞进塔维手里，说先吃，等他出名就没空了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǎoleyìkǒu , cái fāxiàn bǐng lǐ de cōng tàngdé lìhài .
pairs.english: Tavi took a bite, only to discover how fiercely hot the scallions inside were.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维咬了一口，才发现饼里的葱烫得厉害。

pairs.target: tā hán zhe bùgǎn dòng , pà wò zài pángbiān xiào dé jiānbǎng zhí chàn .
pairs.english: He held the mouthful still, afraid to move it, while Pavo laughed beside him, his shoulders shaking.
pairs.hanzi: 他含着不敢动，帕沃在旁边笑得肩膀直颤。

pairs.target: yīwén cóng lù tú nàbiān zǒulái , xiōngqián guà le jiǎngjiě de zhǐpái .
pairs.english: Iven came over from the map with an explainer's card hanging on his chest.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文从路图那边走来，胸前挂了讲解的纸牌。

pairs.target: xīn yìn de biāotí yǐjīng huànchéng chūchá hé cǎoàn ,
pairs.english: The newly printed heading now said “initial survey” and “proposals.”
pairs.hanzi: 新印的标题已经换成初查和草案，

pairs.target: huòchē shàngwèi hézhǔn nà xíng shāo xiǎo , què méiyǒu cáng jìn zhèngwén .
pairs.english: The line saying freight carts were not yet approved was slightly smaller, but had not been hidden in the main text.
pairs.hanzi: 货车尚未核准那行稍小，却没有藏进正文。

pairs.target: nǚ wénshū qiántiān bàngwǎn zhǔn le gǎigǎo , fùqīn yě bǔ shàng liǎngduàn yǐ chámíng de lù .
pairs.english: The clerk had approved the revision the evening before last, and his father had added two confirmed sections of route.
pairs.hanzi: 女文书前天傍晚准了改稿，父亲也补上两段已查明的路。

pairs.target: tā jīntiān chuānzhe zhěngqí de wàiyī , zài ménbiān tóng kèrén shuōhuà , jiàn yīwén guòlái , zhī tì tā fān zhèng le zhǐpái .
pairs.english: Today his father wore a neat coat and talked with guests by the door. Seeing Iven approach, he merely turned the card the right way round for him.
pairs.hanzi: 他今天穿着整齐的外衣，在门边同客人说话，见伊文过来，只替他翻正了纸牌。

alignment.english: turned the card the right way round

pairs.target: " nǐ mànmàn jiǎng , bié yìkǒuqì quán dǎo chūlái . "
pairs.english: “Take your time explaining. Don't pour it all out in one breath.”
pairs.hanzi: “你慢慢讲，别一口气全倒出来。”

pairs.target: yīwén dāying le . tā mōmō zhǐpái , huídào tú qián shí háishì xiān zhǐ le huòchē nà xíng .
pairs.english: Iven agreed. He touched the card, but back at the map he still pointed first to the line about freight carts.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文答应了。他摸摸纸牌，回到图前时还是先指了货车那行。

pairs.target: yíwèi dài háizi de nǚrén wèn , nà jīnnián mǎi mǐ néng bunéng piányi xiē .
pairs.english: A woman with a child asked whether that meant rice could be cheaper this year.
pairs.hanzi: 一位带孩子的女人问，那今年买米能不能便宜些。

pairs.target: yīwén tíng le yíxià , méiyǒu bǎ tú shàng de duǎnlù dàngchéng dáàn .
pairs.english: Iven paused and did not treat the short route on the map as an answer.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文停了一下，没有把图上的短路当成答案。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi tīngjiàn hòumiàn dehuà . wéi lǎoshī cháo zhèbiān zhāoshǒu , dìyī bō kàn liángjù de rén dào le .
pairs.english: Tavi did not hear what followed. Instructor Vey beckoned this way; the first group had arrived to see the measuring instruments.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没听见后面的话。维老师朝这边招手，第一拨看量具的人到了。

pairs.target: luò héng fú zhe kèxiàn zhǐ , tǎ wéi bǎ liǎngzhīshǒu fēnbié fàng shàng pèi hǎo de tiěpiàn .
pairs.english: Lohen steadied the marked paper while Tavi placed one hand on each of the paired iron strips.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡扶着刻线纸，塔维把两只手分别放上配好的铁片。

pairs.target: xiǎo fǎmǎ shǐ piàn duān wēiwēi xiàchuí . tā mànmàn fēnbiàn liǎngbiān de biànhuà ,
pairs.english: Small weights made the tips droop slightly. He slowly distinguished the changes on either side.
pairs.hanzi: 小砝码使片端微微下垂。他慢慢分辨两边的变化，

pairs.target: zuǒbiān zài chén xià yìdiǎn , yòubiān biàn táiqǐ yìdiǎn . wéi lǎoshī diǎntóu , tā jiù sōngshǒu , ràng liǎngbiān huídào yuánchù .
pairs.english: As the left side sank a little farther, the right rose a little. Instructor Vey nodded, and he released them, letting both sides return to their original positions.
pairs.hanzi: 左边再沉下一点，右边便抬起一点。维老师点头，他就松手，让两边回到原处。

pairs.target: yígè lǎorén còujìn le kàn , shuō gāngcái méi kànqīng , néng bunéng lái gè dà de .
pairs.english: An old man leaned closer and said he had not seen clearly just now; could they make it bigger?
pairs.hanzi: 一个老人凑近了看，说刚才没看清，能不能来个大的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hái méi dá , luò héng yǐjīng bǎ zhǐbǎn nuó jìn , qǐng tā kàn yuánlái de xiàn .
pairs.english: Before Tavi could answer, Lohen had moved the card closer and invited him to look at the original line.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维还没答，洛衡已经把纸板挪近，请他看原来的线。

pairs.target: lǎorén fú wěn yǎnjìng , rènchū le nà diǎn chājù , jìng yě mǎnyì .
pairs.english: The old man steadied his glasses, made out that tiny difference, and seemed satisfied after all.
pairs.hanzi: 老人扶稳眼镜，认出了那点差距，竟也满意。

pairs.target: tāmen zuò wán zhè yìlún jiù bǎshǒu cāgān , hēshuǐ xiē zhe .
pairs.english: After this round they dried their hands, drank water, and rested.
pairs.hanzi: 他们做完这一轮就把手擦干，喝水歇着。

pairs.target: duìmiàn de dēngjià xiǎngqǐ mùlún zhuàndòng de shēngyīn .
pairs.english: Across from them came the sound of the lamp stand's wooden wheel turning.
pairs.hanzi: 对面的灯架响起木轮转动的声音。

pairs.target: tèlún bǎ shā dài shēngqǐ , yòu huǎnhuǎn fàngxià , jiēpán lǐ méiyǒu sā chū shā .
pairs.english: Teren raised the sandbag and slowly lowered it again, spilling no sand into the catch tray.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦把砂袋升起，又缓缓放下，接盘里没有撒出砂。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhàn zài páizi páng , yíwèi xiū dēng de kèrén zhèng wèn tā yuánlái de qiáo móxíng .
pairs.english: Mira stood beside the sign while a lamp repairer was asking about her original bridge model.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉站在牌子旁，一位修灯的客人正问她原来的桥模型。

pairs.target: tā ná bǐhuà le yígè huázuò , huà zhe huà zhe , shēntǐ cháo nà rén zhuǎnguò qù le .
pairs.english: She picked up a pen to draw a sliding carriage and, as she drew, turned her body toward the visitor.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿笔画了一个滑座，画着画着，身体朝那人转过去了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hěnjiǔméi jiàn tā zhèyàng shuōqǐ zìjǐ de dōngxī .
pairs.english: It had been a long time since Tavi had seen her speak about her own work like this.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维很久没见她这样说起自己的东西。

pairs.target: tā bú xiào de shíhòu yě xiǎnde kuàihuó , bǐjiān zài zhǐ shàng zǒu dé hěnkuài , yòu tíngxiàlái děng kèrén wèn .
pairs.english: She looked happy even when she wasn't smiling; her pen ran quickly over the paper, then paused to let the visitor ask questions.
pairs.hanzi: 她不笑的时候也显得快活，笔尖在纸上走得很快，又停下来等客人问。

pairs.target: tā běn xiǎng zǒu guòqù , tèlún què jǔqǐ shǒu , qǐng xià yìpái rén kànkàn dǐzuò zěnyàng héng yí .
pairs.english: He was about to go over, but Teren raised a hand, inviting the next row to see how the base moved sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 他本想走过去，特伦却举起手，请下一排人看看底座怎样横移。

pairs.target: dìyīcì xiǎngshēng xiàng yǒurén yòng zhǐjié qiāo le yíxià zhuōzi .
pairs.english: The first sound was like someone tapping the table once with a knuckle.
pairs.hanzi: 第一次响声像有人用指节敲了一下桌子。

pairs.target: dēngjià de dǐzuò tūrán dùnzhù , shù gān piān le yìdiǎn , shā dài pèngshàng mùgān , yòu dàng kāi .
pairs.english: The lamp stand's base stopped abruptly; its upright tilted a little, and the sandbag struck the wooden pole, then swung away.
pairs.hanzi: 灯架的底座突然顿住，竖杆偏了一点，砂袋碰上木杆，又荡开。

pairs.target: tèlún zhuāzhù tí shéng , liǎnshàng de xiào méi láidejí shōu .
pairs.english: Teren caught the lifting cord before the smile had left his face.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦抓住提绳，脸上的笑没来得及收。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī lìkè jiào tā fàngdào pán lǐ , zìjǐ ràoguò zhuō jiǎo , xiān kàn gùdìng cáokǒu de jiājù .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey immediately told him to lower it into the tray and came around the table corner to inspect the clamp securing the channel first.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师立刻叫他放到盘里，自己绕过桌角，先看固定槽口的夹具。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě kànzhe nàbiān , zhídào luò héng chě le chě tā de xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi was watching that way too, until Lohen tugged at his sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也看着那边，直到洛衡扯了扯他的袖子。

pairs.target: dúlì mù zuò shàng de tiě huáng zhèngzài wǎngxiàchén .
pairs.english: The iron spring on the independent wooden stand was sinking.
pairs.hanzi: 独立木座上的铁簧正在往下沉。

pairs.target: tā pángbiān méiyǒu shǒu . xiǎo fǎmǎ réng shì yuánlái de yígè , kèxiàn zhǐ kào zài yuánchù ,
pairs.english: There was no hand beside it. The small weight was still the original one, and the marked paper remained in place.
pairs.hanzi: 它旁边没有手。小砝码仍是原来的一个，刻线纸靠在原处，

pairs.target: mòduān què huǎnmàn yuèguò gāngcái nàtiáo xiàn . tǎ wéi dītóu kàn zìjǐ de shuāngshǒu , yòushǒu hái wò zhe shuǐbēi .
pairs.english: Yet the tip was slowly passing the line where it had just been. Tavi looked down at his own hands; his right still held his water cup.
pairs.hanzi: 末端却缓慢越过刚才那条线。塔维低头看自己的双手，右手还握着水杯。

pairs.target: tā bǎ bēizi fàngxià , xiǎng shuōhuà , hóulóng xiān jǐn le yíxià . " lǎoshī , zhèbiān yě dòng le . "
pairs.english: He put down the cup and wanted to speak, but first his throat tightened. “Instructor, this side moved too.”
pairs.hanzi:
他把杯子放下，想说话，喉咙先紧了一下。
“老师，这边也动了。”

pairs.target: tā shēngyīn bú dà , wéi lǎoshī què tīngjiàn le . tā táitóu shí , liángjù zhuōshàng yíduì tiěpiàn de mòduān yě dǒuqǐlái .
pairs.english: His voice was quiet, but Instructor Vey heard. When she looked up, the tips of the pair of iron strips on the instrument table began trembling too.
pairs.hanzi: 他声音不大，维老师却听见了。她抬头时，量具桌上一对铁片的末端也抖起来。

pairs.target: luò héng shēnshǒu yào fú zhǐ , lǎoshī shuō biépèng , jiào tāmen wǎng hòutuì .
pairs.english: Lohen reached to steady the paper. The instructor told him not to touch it and told them to step back.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡伸手要扶纸，老师说别碰，叫他们往后退。

pairs.target: tèlún yǐjīng bǎ shā dài fàngjìn jiēpán , shéngzi sōng xiàlái .
pairs.english: Teren had already lowered the sandbag into the catch tray, and the cord went slack.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦已经把砂袋放进接盘，绳子松下来。

pairs.target: nà piàn xiǎo zhǐshì huáng réng tiē xiàng cáo dǐ , méiyǒu suí xièzài lìjí tánhuí .
pairs.english: The small indicator spring was still pressed toward the bottom of the channel and had not immediately sprung back when unloaded.
pairs.hanzi: 那片小指示簧仍贴向槽底，没有随卸载立即弹回。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī kàn le tā yìyǎn , ràng tèlún líkāi zhuōbiān , yòu jiào ménpáng de rén xiān chūqù , biéjǐ zài ménkǎn shàng .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey glanced at it, told Teren to leave the table, and asked those by the door to go out first without crowding the threshold.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师看了它一眼，让特伦离开桌边，又叫门旁的人先出去，别挤在门槛上。

pairs.target: yígè háizi wǎngqián zuàn , xiǎng jiǎn diào zài dìshàng de zhǐ mào .
pairs.english: A child ducked forward to retrieve a paper hat that had fallen to the floor.
pairs.hanzi: 一个孩子往前钻，想捡掉在地上的纸帽。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxià tì tā shíqǐlái , bǎ màozi jiāogěi shēnshǒu lái jiē de mǔqīn .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched to pick it up for him, then handed the hat to the mother reaching for it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下替他拾起来，把帽子交给伸手来接的母亲。

pairs.target: qǐshēn shí yǒurén zhuàng zhe tā de jiān , tā tīngjiàn mǐlā zài lìngyìtóu shuō , zhuōzi biébān , xiānràngrén zǒu .
pairs.english: As he stood up, someone struck his shoulder. He heard Mira say at the other end, “Don't move the table. Let people out first.”
pairs.hanzi: 起身时有人撞着他的肩，他听见米拉在另一头说，桌子别搬，先让人走。

pairs.target: sū yǐ bǎmén wánquán tuīkāi , lěngfēng yíxià guànmǎn le wūzi .
pairs.english: Suyi pushed the door fully open, and cold wind flooded the room.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡把门完全推开，冷风一下灌满了屋子。

pairs.target: rénqún qǐchū zhǐshì bàoyuàn kànbújiàn , hòulái tīng chū lǎoshī de shēngyīn bùtóng , cái ānjìng dì wǎng wàiyí .
pairs.english: At first the crowd merely complained that they couldn't see, then heard something different in the instructor's voice and began moving out quietly.
pairs.hanzi: 人群起初只是抱怨看不见，后来听出老师的声音不同，才安静地往外移。

pairs.target: yīwén juǎnqǐ lù tú xiàchuí de yìjiǎo , miǎnde sǎo dào rénliǎn , què méi zài gù lìngyìtóu .
pairs.english: Iven rolled up a hanging corner of the map to keep it from brushing people's faces, but could not attend to its other end.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文卷起路图下垂的一角，免得扫到人脸，却没再顾另一头。

pairs.target: xiū dēng de kèrén fúzhù le zhǐ zhóu , bāng tā yìtóng ràokāi zhuōzi .
pairs.english: The lamp repairer held the paper roller and helped him move around the table together.
pairs.hanzi: 修灯的客人扶住了纸轴，帮他一同绕开桌子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuìhòu huítóu , kànjiàn jiǎn lǎoshī cóng gébì gǎnlái , wéi lǎoshī zhèng zhǐzhe liǎngzhāng zhuōzi shuō shénme .
pairs.english: Looking back one last time, Tavi saw Instructor Jian hurry in from next door, while Instructor Vey pointed at the two tables and said something.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维最后回头，看见简老师从隔壁赶来，维老师正指着两张桌子说什么。

pairs.target: méiyǒu rén liúxuè , dēng yě cóngwèi diǎnzháo .
pairs.english: Nobody was bleeding, and the lamps had never been lit.
pairs.hanzi: 没有人流血，灯也从未点着。

pairs.target: kě nà piàn méiyǒu rén pèng de tiě huáng réng xiàngxià wān zhe , bǐ tā liǎngzhīshǒu fàngshàngqù shí hái ràng tā xīnhuāng .
pairs.english: But the untouched iron spring was still bending downward, frightening him more than when his own two hands had been on the strips.
pairs.hanzi: 可那片没有人碰的铁簧仍向下弯着，比他两只手放上去时还让他心慌。

pairs.target: tāmen bèi lǐngdào yuànzi lìngyìbiān . ménnèi chuánlái xiè fǎmǎ de qīng xiǎng , jiēzhe běi gōngfáng de mén guān le .
pairs.english: They were led to the other side of the courtyard. From inside came soft sounds of weights being removed; then the north workshop door closed.
pairs.hanzi: 他们被领到院子另一边。门内传来卸砝码的轻响，接着北工房的门关了。

pairs.target: pà wò zhǎodào tā , wèn gāngcái zěnme le , tǎ wéi zhī shuō yǒu dōngxī zìjǐ dòng le .
pairs.english: Pavo found him and asked what had happened. Tavi said only that something had moved by itself.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃找到他，问刚才怎么了，塔维只说有东西自己动了。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shèngxià de bǐng cóng yīdài lǐ ná chūlái , zhǐ yǐjīng yābiǎn .
pairs.english: He took the remaining bread out of his pocket; the paper had been crushed flat.
pairs.hanzi: 他把剩下的饼从衣袋里拿出来，纸已经压扁。

pairs.target: yǎo xiàqù shí cōng bú tàng le , tā què wàng le jiáo .
pairs.english: When he bit into it, the scallions were no longer hot, but he forgot to chew.
pairs.hanzi: 咬下去时葱不烫了，他却忘了嚼。
